commands:
printf %b "Hi,\n
The jail o-a-mail-whois has been started successfully.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban"|mail -E 'set escape' -s "[Fail2Ban] o-a-mail-whois: started on <fq-hostname>" root

printf %b "Hi,\n
The jail o-a-mail-whois has been stopped.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban"|mail -E 'set escape' -s "[Fail2Ban] o-a-mail-whois: stopped on <fq-hostname>" root

printf %b "Hi,\n
The IP <ip> has just been banned by Fail2Ban after
<failures> attempts against o-a-mail-whois.\n\n
Here is more information about <ip> :\n
`whois <ip> || echo "missing whois program"`\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban"|mail -E 'set escape' -s "[Fail2Ban] o-a-mail-whois: banned <ip> from <fq-hostname>" root
